_comment: Template for role DEFINITIONS only — names, labels, and which environments each role applies to. On first run this seeds roles.json (git-ignored). NEVER put credentials here: usernames/passwords live only in your private .env (env-scoped <ENV>_<ROLE>_* or shared <ROLE>_*), added via Settings → Logins. 'envs' is either "all" (one shared login on every site) or a list like ["demo","staging"] (a different login per site).
